subject: Re: Service disruption on Oct 9 — settlement path and ask
messages:
From: Brian Chen <brian.chen@bluepeak.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Lopez <samira.lopez@bluepeak.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Service disruption on Oct 9 — impact & ask

Vanessa,

Thanks for taking my call this morning. To summarize: on Oct 9 between 05:10–05:45 PDT our production pipelines saw repeated 500s and ~3x normal token latency while routing to the hosted Redwood API. Our ML jobs process gigabytes of batched requests; delays caused a backlog and we missed a morning shipping window for our customers.

We’ve compiled a short impact summary (attached incident-timeline.pdf) and the raw usage/ingestion spikes (usage-report-oct-sep.csv). BluePeak’s COGS for that window is material — we’re estimating ~$18k in remediation costs and SLA-derived exposure.

Request: given the outage and the fact we’re a mid-sized committed customer (monthly committed spend ~ $45k), we’d like Redwood to propose a settlement — credit or account offset covering remediation costs + a goodwill concession (one or two service months). Please include timeline for approval and any supporting docs you need from our side.

We appreciate the quick turnaround. Samira will own procurement details on our side.

Thanks,
Brian
Head of Platform
BluePeak Analytics

[attachment: incident-timeline.pdf]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Brian Chen <brian.chen@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: Samira Lopez <samira.lopez@bluepeak.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service disruption on Oct 9 — impact & ask

Hi Brian — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. I’m really sorry for the disruption; I know how painful missed shipping windows are.

Quick notes: we’re already tracking this in SUP-3321 and our infra team ran a post-mortem discovery yesterday. Early root cause points to a transient routing flapping event when the primary pool reached a rare kernel-level contention during a wide burst. Not a configuration change on your side.

Internal ask for me: can I loop Karthik (ops lead) and Marissa (revenue lead) to evaluate a settlement path? I’ve attached a proposed-draft (proposed-settlement-draft.docx) with two options: a one-month account credit + $8k service remediation offset, or a two-week credit + $12k remediation.

Brian — if you can confirm which you prefer we’ll expedite the approval paperwork and procurement flow.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
[attachment: proposed-settlement-draft.docx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Service disruption on Oct 9 — settlement path and ask

Vanessa / Marissa — looping you in per Vanessa’s note. I reviewed the incident timeline; operational cause appears limited and resolved, and BluePeak’s account shows consistent usage and committed spend. From an ops perspective I’m comfortable recommending a remediation credit; need exec sign-off on amount and whether we treat this as one-off vs. precedence-setting.

My recommendation: offer Option A from Vanessa’s draft but split the remediation into a vendor reimbursement credit (covering documented remediation expenses up to $9k with receipts) + a prorated account credit equal to one-month commitment (applied to next invoice). Keep language that this is a one-time goodwill settlement, not an SLA precedent.

Connor — please confirm we can implement the credit in billing and tag it so finance has audit trail.

Karthik
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Service disruption on Oct 9 — settlement path and ask

Agree with Karthik’s framing. From a revenue & retention perspective BluePeak is strategic and at a cross-sell inflection (they’re evaluating Redwood Dedicated next quarter). I am inclined to approve the higher remediation cap ($12k) if we attach a short covenant: BluePeak signs a 9-month committed addendum for the Dedicated evaluation (non-binding PoC opt-in is fine) or we secure a renewal/expansion commitment by end of Q1. Otherwise default to the $9k+1 month credit.

Vanessa — please get Samira’s procurement preference and make the ask explicit. Also include a simple one-page settlement letter that makes this one-off and non-precedential.

M

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Brian Chen <brian.chen@bluepeak.ai>, Samira Lopez <samira.lopez@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Settlement options & ask from BluePeak

Brian / Samira — per internal review we can offer two settlement structures:

Option 1 (standard): One-month account credit applied to next invoice + remediation credit up to $9,000 pending receipts. One-off, non-precedential.

Option 2 (preferred for BluePeak retention): One-month account credit + remediation credit up to $12,000, conditional on a 9-month committed evaluation addendum for Redwood Dedicated (simple opt-in PoC clause; no automatic billing). If you don’t want the addendum we default to Option 1.

Can you confirm which option you prefer and share receipts for remediation costs (if requesting the remediation credit)? Once you confirm we’ll route the settlement letter and billing offset.

— Vanessa

From: Samira Lopez <samira.lopez@bluepeak.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Brian Chen <brian.chen@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Settlement options & ask from BluePeak

Vanessa — thanks. BluePeak accepts Option 2 (the higher remediation cap) but we want the addendum to be limited: evaluation only, 9 months, with an explicit cancel clause and no minimum spend beyond our current commitment. We’ll provide remediation receipts this afternoon.

Brian (internal): pls attach receipts and a short accounting memo.

Samira
Director, Procurement
BluePeak Analytics

[attachment: remediation_receipts.zip]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Brian Chen <brian.chen@bluepeak.ai>, Samira Lopez <samira.lopez@bluepeak.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: BluePeak settlement (one-off)

Team / BluePeak — I approve Option 2 as a one-off settlement on these conditions:
- Remediation reimbursements capped at $12,000 and paid only against submitted receipts (finance will validate).
- One-month account credit applied to the next invoice, coded as goodwill, with internal memo referencing SUP-3321.
- A short settlement letter will be executed acknowledging this is a single-instance concession and not an SLA amendment.
- The 9-month Dedicated evaluation addendum is limited to an opt-in PoC and contains no additional spend guarantees; legal to review final language.

Connor — proceed with billing implementation and tagging. Marissa — please prepare the settlement letter template; Vanessa — coordinate signature and DocuSign.

Thanks — Karthik
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference
